title: Design: Bill To list opening upward runs over the app's top bar
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Start on customer B's page with the window 900 pixels tall.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-14-after-change-open.png, bt-p3-17-after-change-bill-to.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click Change under Bill Invoices To.
  2. Click the Bill Invoices To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens.

Step 2:

  • The list opens above the field and reaches the top of the browser window, covering part of the app's top bar.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R4: “The window has a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field and a "Save" button.”
